name: cambium
whole: a renewable public skin carries a particular body of meaning into a legible, addressable encounter, and can change its expression without losing either its carried distinctions or its navigational truth.

_stomach.whole: unresolved launch work and retained derivational nutrient whose remaining value has not yet earned further living structure.

_waste.whole: spent residue whose living function has ended.

SKILLS.whole: the organism-local re-entry receptor and pointers to the shared physiology that governs this body.

w.name: expression
w.whole: the encounterable surface through which carried meaning and resolved position become perceptible as composition, typography, geometry and interaction.

x.name: continuity
x.whole: the public meaning that remains available while expression changes: approved wording and distinctions are carried without making one presentation their identity.

z.name: orientation
z.whole: the lawful relation by which a visitor knows where they are, through which approach they arrived, and which realized destinations the current body actually admits.

y.name: renewal
y.whole: the capacity by which the public skin is rebuilt, challenged, corrected and regenerated as the living body changes.
